hooks.command: echo '=== DR-NRPG Session Started ===' && echo 'Stack: Next.js 14 · Prisma · Supabase · Redis · Tailwind v3' && echo 'Live: https://disasterrecovery.com.au' && echo 'Rules: 9 active | Commands: 21 | Agents: 27' && echo 'Fullscreen: '"$( [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER" = '1' ] && echo 'ON (PgUp/PgDn scroll, Ctrl+o transcript)' || echo 'OFF — set CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1' )" && echo 'Read CLAUDE.md → .claude/PROGRESS.md before starting work.'

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [[ -n "$FILE" ]] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '(\.env|\.env\..*|\.env\.local|secrets/|.*\.pem$|.*\.key$|.*\.p12$|.*\.pfx$)'; then echo "BLOCKED: '$FILE' is a protected file. Use environment variable management instead." >&2; exit 2; fi

CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git push.*--force[^-]|git push.*--force$'; then echo "BLOCKED: force push is not allowed. Use --force-with-lease if required and confirm with project lead." >&2; exit 2; fi

CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git (commit|push).*(origin )?main'; then echo "BLOCKED: direct commits/pushes to main are not allowed. Use a feat/ or fix/ branch and open a PR." >&2; exit 2; fi

CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE '(DROP\s+(TABLE|DATABASE|SCHEMA|INDEX)|TRUNCATE\s+TABLE|rm\s+-rf\s+/)'; then echo "BLOCKED: destructive command detected (DROP/TRUNCATE/rm -rf /). Confirm with project lead before running." >&2; exit 2; fi

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [[ -n "$FILE" ]] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|css)$'; then cd "$(dirname "$FILE")" 2>/dev/null; npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [[ -n "$FILE" ]] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$' && echo "$FILE" | grep -v 'node_modules'; then ERRORS=$(npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -10); if [[ -n "$ERRORS" ]]; then echo 'TypeScript errors detected:' >&2; echo "$ERRORS" >&2; fi; fi

CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); LOGDIR="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/logs"; mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"; echo "{\"ts\":\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\",\"cmd\":\"$(echo $CMD | head -c 200)\"}" >> "$LOGDIR/bash-audit.log" 2>/dev/null || true

PROJ="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"; PROGRESS="$PROJ/.claude/PROGRESS.md"; TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ); DIFF=$(cd "$PROJ" 2>/dev/null && git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | head -20 || echo 'no git changes'); if [[ -f "$PROGRESS" ]]; then printf '
### Auto-logged: %s
Modified files:
%s
' "$TS" "$DIFF" >> "$PROGRESS" 2>/dev/null; fi; echo '' >&2; echo '=== Session End Checklist ===' >&2; echo 'Before closing, confirm:' >&2; echo '  [ ] pnpm run type-check — passes (zero errors)' >&2; echo '  [ ] pnpm run test — all tests pass' >&2; echo '  [ ] Changes committed to a feat/ or fix/ branch' >&2; echo '  [ ] .claude/PROGRESS.md updated with session decisions' >&2; exit 0

BACKUP_DIR="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/backups"; mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"; PROGRESS="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/PROGRESS.md"; if [[ -f "$PROGRESS" ]]; then cp "$PROGRESS" "$BACKUP_DIR/PROGRESS-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).md" && echo "PROGRESS.md backed up to $BACKUP_DIR" >&2; fi

echo '=== Context Compacted ===' >&2; echo 'Re-reading critical context...' >&2; PROJ="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"; echo '--- CONSTITUTION (7 immutable rules) ---' >&2; head -60 "$PROJ/.claude/memory/CONSTITUTION.md" 2>/dev/null >&2; echo '--- PROGRESS (active tasks) ---' >&2; head -40 "$PROJ/.claude/PROGRESS.md" 2>/dev/null >&2; echo '--- Reminders: mobile-first, claim intake <90s, OLED black #050505, rounded-sm, Framer Motion only, no phone/email/address in UI ---' >&2

powershell.exe -Command "[System.Reflection.Assembly]::LoadWithPartialName('System.Windows.Forms'); [System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox]::Show('Claude Code needs your attention — DR-NRPG', 'Disaster Recovery NRPG')" 2>/dev/null || notify-send 'DR-NRPG' 'Claude Code needs your attention' 2>/dev/null || true
echo 'Subagent spawned. Rules: scope narrowly, return summary only, do not pollute main context. Load only relevant skills (max 5-6 per invocation).' >&2

hooks.prompt: BEFORE committing: Run npx tsc first and verify zero TypeScript errors. If tsc fails, fix all errors before allowing the commit to proceed. Respond with the tsc result.
